presets.label: Light
presets.note: ClickHouse wins the heavy queries 1.5–6×, but at 10–90 ms on Postgres everything still feels instant. Postgres wins the lookups.

presets.label: Standard
presets.note: Heavy queries: Postgres ~20–400 ms vs ClickHouse ~8–35 ms (up to 15×). Postgres still wins the lookups.

presets.label: Large
presets.note: Heavy queries: Postgres ~0.1–3 s vs ClickHouse ~15–130 ms (up to 25×). The gap is plainly felt.
presets.warning: Uses about 620 MB of disk (up to ~760 MB for a few seconds while loading), almost 4× the default size.
